en.description:
Zombie Isles is a complete survival game — now on Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad. The full game is on every device, with controls built for each one: the Digital Crown on your wrist, thumb-sized controls and a wide camera on phone and tablet. Your progress follows you across all of them.
Play 14 different gamemodes including:
CLASSIC
Survive endless waves of zombies while going from island to island, finding unique weapons and items to use in battle. Fight bosses and zombies in battles across land and sea! Find secret items that bring your game up to the next level, show off your skills by fighting off hardcore zombies with only your fists, or even explore all nine of the islands. The possibilities are endless!
ARENA
Fight wave after wave of zombies in the torch-lit Arena! Every wave tests your confidence, getting harder and harder endlessly. No breaks, no chests; no one said it was going to be easy!
BOSS BATTLE
Face a colossal boss many times your size. A new boss takes the arena every hour, each with its own name, powers, and three escalating phases — teleports, laser beams, decoy duplicates, mega shields and more. Defeat one and claim its exclusive character skin.
DEFENSE
You don't just fight to survive here — wave after wave of zombies are gunning for the generator, and it's your job to stop them. It's like the Arena… except a whole lot deadlier!
GAUNTLET
Every floor you clear (up until floor ten) grants a new ability. Stack your powers and master your build, because after floor 10 the buffs stop… and the floors never do. How deep can you go?
DISASTERS
Zombies aren't the only thing to worry about. Fight the horde while steering clear of tornadoes, keep warm as the blizzard blurs your vision, or fight to stay afloat while the hurricane drags you in. Seven deadly disasters. Try to survive them all!
RATED & TOURNAMENTS
A 1v1 duel against a zombie of similar skill to you — your equal in size, speed, health, damage and cooldowns, so only the smarter fighter wins. They switch between bow and sword, and a well-timed shield will parry you cold. Gain rating with every victory, fight into tournaments, or challenge yourself to a 1v3, 1v5, or even a 1v10.
SABOTEUR
The zombies have hired YOU to find the one among them that's gone rogue. Study the crowd, track your suspects, and stop the rogue before it comes for you. One wrong kill and you lose — and the round ends by showing you exactly who it was.
SHOWDOWN
100 rivals across twelve islands. Scavenge weapons, outrun the shrinking storm, and be the last one standing — and watch your back, because the zombies fight each other too.
CAPTURE THE FLAG
Lead your own squad as raiders push the enemy base and escorts guard you. Steal their flag and run it home — but get hit while carrying and you drop it.
HORDE NIGHT
Pick 3, 5 or 10 minutes and a difficulty, then hold out until dawn. The night only gets darker and the horde only gets bigger.
KING OF THE ISLE
Hold the crown zone while the island tries to take it back. Step outside and your reign ends. Endless — the horde just gets angrier.
AND MORE
Lucky mode where every chest is a gamble, a Practice mode to master the parry, and a Prize Vault full of exclusive skins.
FEATURES
• 14 game modes, endlessly replayable
• Play on Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad — progress syncs across all of them
• 46 zombie types, from shamblers to wizards to the TITAN
• Rare DARK variants — stronger, deadlier, and almost never seen
• 15 bosses, each with three phases and its own trophy skin
• Dozens of weapons: swords, bows, spears, clubs, hammers and axes
• Gadgets: dynamite, smoke bombs, frost grenades, caltrops and more
• 68 collectible characters, including boss trophies and golden skins
• A rating ladder and 32-fighter tournaments
• 95 achievements
• Daily quests, login streaks and a rotating daily world event
• Plays entirely offline — no sign-up, no ads, no data collected
SCAVENGE • FIGHT • SURVIVE
Made by Arman Brewer

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Hi! Hope you have been enjoying Zombie Isles so far. Zombie Isles 1.2 just dropped.
New in 1.2:
-Now on iPhone and iPad!
Thats right, you can now also play Zombie Isles on your phone or iPad. The whole game is there, with controls built for a bigger screen.
-Your progress follows you
Play on your watch, pick it up on your phone. Coins, levels, unlocks and characters all stay in sync across your devices.
-Two brand new gamemodes!
HORDE NIGHT - pick 3, 5 or 10 minutes and a difficulty, then survive until dawn. The night only gets darker and the horde only gets bigger.
KING OF THE ISLE - hold the crown zone while the whole island tries to take it from you. Step outside and your reign is over. Endless, and the horde only gets angrier.
-New and updated gamemodes!
Rated, Showdown, and Saboteur are now new and updated with cool features.
RATED - your opponent is now a true mirror of you. Same health, same damage, same cooldowns. They swap between bow and sword depending on the range, and a well timed shield will parry you cold. Rating is friendlier too, so a bad run wont undo a good week. And no more sneaking out of a duel you are losing.
SABOTEUR - when the round ends, the camera now flies over and zooms right in on the imposter, so you always find out who it was.
-Daily Tasks and Daily Events
Every day, get one of 7 rotating daily events, like double coins, meteor shower, and more. Also, you get three tasks every day to complete. Currently only for iPhone and iPad.
-Rare Events
Every once in a while, you will get rare event, like Trillionaire Tuesday and Fortune Friday! Currently only for iPhone and iPad.
-Login streaks
Come back each day and the rewards get bigger, all the way up to a 7 day streak. Currently only for iPhone and iPad.
-A What's New screen
Tap it right from the menu to see everything that shipped and whats coming next. Now on Apple Watch too.
-Fixes and polish
Bigger, easier to read text on iPad. HUD text no longer hides behind the clock on Apple Watch. Plus a pile of smaller fixes all over the game.
Thanks for playing!
